description:
Returns one project as readable text: header with dates and counts, tasks in plan order (duration, progress, slack and whether critical), dependencies, people, calendars and baselines.
On large projects the task list is truncated: use taskLimit to see more, parentTask to open one branch, search to filter, onlyCritical for critical tasks only.
The `rif` column (task key, e.g. Cronos-12) is the reference to use in other tools. Read-only.

onlyCritical.description: Show only tasks on the critical path.

parentTask.description: Show only the subtree under this task.

projectId.description: Project id (uuid), as returned by planitude_list_projects.

search.description: Text filter on task name, WBS code and notes.

taskLimit.description: How many tasks to show. Default 60, maximum 400.

name: planitude_get_project
title: Get project details
